title: Query parameters of POST /api/v1/upload (the body is the raw file)
description: Streamed attachment upload for owner and coordinator tokens, up to BOARD_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES (default 64 MiB). Journaled as an ordinary attachment.add event; request_id deduplicates retries exactly like POST /api/v1/write. purpose=message: an image pasted into a message (png/jpeg/webp/gif only, at most 5 MiB), linked by feedback.add attachments.
